Definition: from G5158 and G5409; to endure one's habits:--suffer the manners.
BiblicalUsage: tropophoréō is the word for to endure one's habits. It appears once, in Acts 13:18.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tropophoréō because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
